game_title: Function Test Arena – Frozen Gatehouse Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frost imps.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frost imps. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the frozen well using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the frozen well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Frozen Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The frozen well reached with actions_used <= 18.
